title: Get started with zugrpc
text: channel holds connection one server. http:// URL cleartext HTTP/2, local server. https:// URL negotiates HTTP/2 TLS.
code: ch <- grpc_channel("http://localhost:15002")  ch <- grpc_channel(   "https://spark.example.org:443",   tls = zuhttp::zu_tls(ca_file = NULL),   headers = c(authorization = "Bearer ..."),   keepalive = grpc_keepalive(time = 60, timeout = 20),   max_message = 128 * 1024^2 )

title: Get started with zugrpc
text: unary call sends one request message returns one response message. request raw vector, typically zuproto::proto_encode(). deadline seconds, absolute POSIXct.
code: # Open: whether grpc_call() returns a plain list or an S3 object with accessors res <- grpc_call(   ch, "/spark.connect.SparkConnectService/AnalyzePlan",   request = req_bytes,   metadata = c("x-user-agent" = "zuspark"),   deadline = 30 ) res$message res$headers res$trailers res$status

title: Get started with zugrpc
text: server-streaming call returns stream. $next_message() returns one response message, NULL end. server sends read. Cancel stream longer need. second cancel nothing.
code: st <- grpc_stream(   ch, "/spark.connect.SparkConnectService/ExecutePlan",   request = req_bytes, deadline = 600 ) st$headers() # Open: should $next_message() take a timeout of its own, or is the call # deadline enough? while (!is.null(m <- st$next_message())) {   zuproto::proto_decode(m, type, pool) } st$trailers() st$status() st$cancel()

title: Get started with zugrpc
text: call ends non-OK status raises zugrpc_error_status condition. class also carries status, can catch one code. details field holds decoded google.rpc.Status.
code: tryCatch(   grpc_call(ch, "/spark.connect.SparkConnectService/AnalyzePlan",             request = req_bytes),   zugrpc_error_unavailable = function(cnd) {     cnd$message   },   zugrpc_error_status = function(cnd) {     cnd$details   } )  grpc_status_codes()
